canonical_project: AWS Palava Data Center (Lodha Industrial Park)
owner: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Data Services India)
notes: AWS's first Maharashtra data centre campus: foundation stone virtually laid by CM Fadnavis 23 Sep 2025 as part of AWS's USD 8.3bn state commitment; site at Lodha Industrial Park, Palava (Thane district); dcpulse lists ~473 MW planned IT load on 48.8 acres.
